trickyParts: A held socket accepts and queues connections before the server serves, so every readiness poll against one carries a timeout and waits for the server's own listening line (dispatch and listener launchers, memory harness, search scripts, Stage 1).
The listener inspects ENVOY_LISTEN_FD in config.Load, before the API-auth fence, and takes the socket's IP as ListenHost, so a 0.0.0.0 socket without credentials is refused.
legion start adopts the socket before config.Load runs key commands and unsets LEGION_LISTEN_FD, so neither children nor panes inherit fd 3 or the variable.
The host wrapper receives the socket over an abstract unix socket (host network shares the namespace) and execs the listener in place; first container run of this is in CI's envoy-smoke.
The Playwright config can no longer start servers: e2e/run.ts starts the harness and exports the ports before Playwright evaluates, so every import-time port read sees real ports.
deviations: envoy-smoke builds the held-port image with docker/build-push-action and the Dockerfile compiles the wrapper in a Go stage, because .github/scripts/check-image-trigger-paths.sh refuses a plain docker build step and a COPY of a CI-built binary.
listenfd.CheckAgainst takes two Setting{Name, Value, Set} values instead of four positional arguments, so refusals name each setting.
Every scripts/e2e daemon start uses a keeper (keep_port + start_kept), not only restarts: legion.yaml must name the port before legion start runs.
run-server.sh gained DISPATCH_E2E_LISTEN_FROM (a keeper's socket) for the broker docs rig, which needs Dispatch's port before the broker starts.
